title: Affirmative Employment Program | OEEO | CDC
content: October 1, 2024 Affirmative Employment Program At a glance The Affirmative Employment Program at CDC/ATSDR ensures fair recruitment, placement and retaining of qualified individuals who are typically underrepresented in the workplace. Managers and supervisors are required to not only develop strategies to complete these activities, but to also actively remove any barriers to entry. October 1, 2024 Sources Print Share Facebook LinkedIn Twitter Syndicate Content Source: About the Office of Equal Employment Opportunity and Workplace Equity (OEEOWE)
